summary: Verified Fourbuy Deal Outcomes auto-expiry (14 -> 30 days, anchored to created_at). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_auto_expire_deal_outcomes.py — confirmed ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS=30 constant, seeded a 45-day-old priced submission with no dealer outcome and confirmed the sweep flipped it to deal.done=false + deal.auto_expired=true + deal.expired_at=<iso> + deal.updated_by_name='System (expired)', confirmed the sweep is IDEMPOTENT (expired_at unchanged on second hit), confirmed the sweep fires from GET /api/stats/deal-outcomes/list, GET /api/stats/deal-outcomes, and GET /api/admin/stats/deal-outcomes-by-dealer, confirmed pending/declined records >30 days old are UNTOUCHED, confirmed the list row shape now includes auto_expired + expired_at fields, and confirmed PATCH /api/submissions/{id}/deal with done=true clears the auto_expired flag (auto_expired=false, expired_at=null) on override. Regression schema for /list still holds (period_days=90, counts/percentages/pending/deal_done/no_deal, sum-to-100 invariant, no _id leaks). Frontend: verified as dave@fourbuy.co.za on 390x844 viewport that the auto-expired chip renders on the seeded row inside the No Deal bucket (data-testid=`auto-expired-TEST-EXP-31D232`, amber 'Auto-expired · tap to override' with clock icon), and tapping the row navigates to /vehicle/{id}.
action_items: None — feature works end-to-end. Note: dave@fourbuy.co.za password was found rotated in preview DB; testing agent reset it back to 'Dave1234!' via POST /api/admin/dealers/{id}/password (payload key is `new_password`, not `password`).
Consider adding a 'Manual override' toast confirmation on the vehicle detail screen when a dealer flips an auto-expired outcome to Deal Done — currently silent success (UX polish, not a blocker).

Consider capping the sweep query's `$in` shape via an explicit `deal.auto_expired: {$ne: true}` guard for extra defensive idempotency, though current WHERE (deal.done in {null,missing}) already handles this correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auto_expire_pending_deal_outcomes correctly merges caller-scope $or via $and so dealer scope + null-outcome disjunction both apply (line 450-457). Verified with the seeded pending/declined records staying untouched.
server.py compute_bucket now anchors to created_at (fallback submitted_at -> priced_at -> declined_at) — matches spec (line 383).
server.py update_submission_deal PATCH clears auto_expired + expired_at on ANY done value transition when prev.auto_expired was set (line 4933-4935). Matches spec.

server.py deal_outcomes_list still filters by priced_at >= 90 days (line 1022) while the SWEEP filters by created_at < 30 days — these two windows are consistent: any priced sub 30-90 days old (by created_at) will be in the list and eligible to be swept. Older-than-90-day rows fall off the report entirely, which is by design.

deal-outcomes.tsx line 254-259: auto_expired chip only renders inside the row title column; row background/border unchanged. Good — a bolder highlight (e.g., left border stripe) could improve scanability but is not required by the spec.
seed_data_creation: Seeded a TEST-EXP-* priced submission (created_at = now-45d, deal={}) owned by dave@fourbuy.co.za via motor client for both pytest and frontend playwright. All TEST-EXP-* rows are hard-deleted on teardown/cleanup script (verified DELETED=1 at the end of the run). No prod-like data was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For future auto-expiry regression: use /app/backend/tests/seed_auto_expired_sub.py to seed a stale priced submission and /app/backend/tests/test_auto_expire_deal_outcomes.py for the full pytest suite. Dave's password is 'Dave1234!' (was rotated in preview DB during iteration_50 setup — reset via POST /api/admin/dealers/{id}/password with body {"new_password":"Dave1234!"}). The admin reset endpoint requires the JSON key `new_password` (not `password`), which is worth flagging if future tests hit 422s.
